title: Tiny Toon Adventures - Wacky Stackers
sources: own RAM search with gbaverify: the HUD level 1 -> 2 -> 1 (new game) matched bytes at 0x030010BC and 0x030010C0; the first is used

widgets.text:
Score; stack pieces
Falling-block puzzle with Tiny Toons characters: stack and match pieces to clear them

Stack characters to match
Game types from the menu: play against 1-3 other people, against the computer, solve the Tiny Toons puzzles, or play against the clock

rows: clearing big groups sends trouble to the opponent's stack

widgets.text:
Puzzle and VS
Puzzle mode is a sequence of set puzzles; bonus challenges appear between them

Next pieces
The next piece is shown beside the well; plan where it lands before it drops

Characters unlocked
Characters and movies unlock as you clear puzzles and challenges

Stages cleared
Puzzles and challenges cleared; the final hurdle closes the puzzle mode
